title: Someone, Anyone, No One ve Nesne Betimleme
subtitle: Günlük mesajlarda belirsiz kişi ve şeylerden söz et; şekil, boyut ve doku ayrıntılarıyla nesneleri açıkça tarif et.

learn.title: Kim olduğunu bilmiyorsan ne dersin?
learn.intro: Bir kişiyi veya şeyi tam olarak bilmiyorsan someone, anyone, no one, something, anything ve nothing ile doğal bir mesaj kurabilirsin.

cards.title: Olumlu haber
cards.text: Olumlu bir cümlede belirsiz bir kişi için someone, belirsiz bir şey için something kullan.
examples: Someone left a parcel at reception.
There is something soft inside the bag.

cards.title: Soru ve kontrol
cards.text: Bir kişi ya da şey olup olmadığını sorarken genellikle anyone veya anything kullan.
examples: Is there anything in the box?

cards.title: Olumsuz mesaj
cards.text: Not ile kurulan olumsuz cümlede anyone veya anything kullan.

cards.title: Sıfır kişi veya şey
cards.text: No one ve nothing zaten olumsuz anlam taşır; aynı cümlede not kullanma.

cards.title: Tekil fiil
cards.text: Bu sözcüklerden sonra kişi veya şey sayısı bilinmese de tekil fiil kullanılır.

learn.title: Şekil, boyut ve doku ile doğru nesneyi bul
learn.intro: İyi bir tarif, nesnenin şeklini, boyutunu ve yüzeyini günlük bir amaçla açıklar.

cards.title: Şekil
cards.text: Round, square, rectangular ve triangular nesnenin biçimini söyler.

cards.title: Boyut
cards.text: Large/small genel boyutu; long/short uzunluğu; thick/thin kalınlığı anlatır.

cards.title: Doku
cards.text: Smooth ve rough yüzeyi; soft ve hard dokununca hissedileni anlatır.

cards.title: Doğal sıralama
cards.text: Birden çok sıfat kullanırken genel boyut çoğunlukla şekilden önce gelir.

cards.title: Kullanışlı tarif
cards.text: Tarifi gerçek bir amaçla tamamla: kayıp eşyayı bulmak, ürünü seçmek veya birine yol göstermek.
examples: Has anyone seen my small black bag?
I need something soft and thick for the sofa.

read.title: A Parcel at Reception
read.instructions: Görevlinin doğru paketi bulmasına yardım eden ayrıntılı cümlelere dokun.
read.selectionExplanation: Seçtiğin cümleler paketin şeklini, boyutunu, dokusunu veya kime ait olabileceğini açıkça belirtiyor.

tokens.text: Someone left a parcel at the community centre reception.
It is a medium-sized rectangular box with a smooth white label.
There is something soft inside because the box bends slightly.
No one wrote a phone number on it.
The weather was cool that morning.
A volunteer remembered seeing someone in a green coat carrying it.

questions.explanation: The first sentence gives the exact location.

questions.prompt: Which description would help a volunteer identify the parcel?
options: A medium rectangular box with a smooth white label
A large round basket with a rough handle
questions.answer: A medium rectangular box with a smooth white label
questions.explanation: The text states its size, shape and label texture.

questions.prompt: Why does the receptionist think the parcel contains something soft?
questions.explanation: The bending box is the evidence given in the text.

questions.prompt: What useful information is missing from the parcel?
questions.explanation: The text says no one wrote a phone number on it.

extra.title: The Lost-and-Found Table
extra.instructions: Metni oku ve her cevabı doğrudan bir ayrıntıyla destekle.
paragraphs: After Saturday's craft fair, the community centre had several objects on its lost-and-found table. There was a small round mirror with a smooth silver frame, a long blue scarf made of soft wool and a thick square notebook with a rough brown cover. No one knew who owned them.

Mina posted a message in the neighbourhood group: 'Did anyone lose anything at the fair? Please describe it before you come.' Someone replied that the mirror belonged to her. She said it had a tiny star on the back, and Mina found the star immediately.

Later, a man asked for the scarf, but he described a short green scarf. Mina explained that nothing on the table matched his description. The blue scarf and the notebook stayed at reception so their owners could collect them later.

questions.prompt: Which item had a rough surface?
questions.explanation: Its brown cover is described as rough.

questions.prompt: What detail proved that the mirror belonged to the person who replied?
options: A tiny star on the back
questions.answer: A tiny star on the back
questions.explanation: Mina checked this specific detail and found it.

questions.prompt: Why didn't Mina give the scarf to the man?
questions.explanation: He described a short green scarf, but the item was long and blue.

questions.prompt: What remained at reception at the end?
questions.explanation: The final sentence names the two remaining items.

questions.prompt: Why did Mina ask owners to describe their items first?
options: To check that each item went to the right person
To change the fair's opening time
questions.answer: To check that each item went to the right person
questions.explanation: A matching description provides evidence of ownership.

formats.title: Mesajları oku ve kendi cümlenle cevapla

passage: Reception posted: 'Someone left a long blue scarf after the workshop. It is soft, thick and has a square label.'
Eda replied: 'I lost something yesterday, but my scarf is short and green. It has a round metal badge.'
Reception answered: 'Nothing in your description matches this scarf. Has anyone else lost one? Please send one detail that is not visible in our post.'

items.prompt: What item did reception find?
items.answer: Reception found a long blue scarf.
items.explanation: The first message names and describes the item.

items.prompt: Give two details about the found scarf.
items.explanation: The post gives several acceptable details, including long, blue, soft, thick and a square label.

items.prompt: Why is the found scarf probably not Eda's?
items.answer: Her scarf is short and green, but the found scarf is long and blue.
items.explanation: The size and colour details conflict.

items.prompt: What kind of detail should another claimant send?
items.answer: They should send a detail that is not visible in the public post.
items.explanation: Reception asks for private identifying evidence.

items.prompt: What does reception mean by “Nothing in your description matches”?
items.answer: None of Eda's details describe the found scarf.
items.explanation: Nothing indicates that zero details match.
